newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai shares down 4.2 pct by noon on fragile baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai shares down 4.2 pct by noon on fragile baht.

text.p: Thai shares fell further at the midday break on Thursday amid concern about the stability of the baht and severely tight liquidity in the banking system, brokers said.
The SET index dropped 23.99 points or 4.20 percent to 547.32 on 2.9 billion baht trade by the midday break. The SET-50 fell 2.08 points to 39.54.

"It's another selloff by foreigners today," said one broker at Ekachart Finance and Securities."Besides the baht worry, the tightening liquidity also prompted some investors to move (funds) to the money market."
